violated_contract: A Vertex cachedContents resource created for Gemini must be reusable for its TTL when Vertex returns a valid resource name. The gateway currently accepts only a project-ID prefix while Vertex may return a project-number prefix; rejecting that handle drops the local entry but leaves the 30-minute storage charge, so repeated requests create new paid resources even though implicit caching already serves reads.
canonical_prevention: Accept and retain cachedContents handles with either the configured project ID or its numeric project-number prefix, and keep Gemini lanes on implicit caching until that validation is fixed. Pin both the accepted handle forms and the no-create policy for affected Gemini lanes with hermetic tests; preserve OpenAI explicit caching.
